# GET /api/v1/users/{username}/following

List the users that the given user is following

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** optional (affects visibility filtering) · **ID:** `ep-142`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| username | path | string | True |
| page | query | integer | False |
| limit | query | integer | False |

## Response

**200** — []*api.User

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int64 | user ID |
| `login` | string | username |
| `full_name` | string | full name |
| `email` | string | email (may be placeholder) |
| `avatar_url` | string | avatar URL |
| `followers_count` | int | number of followers |
| `following_count` | int | number of following |

- **404** — username does not exist

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | user.ListFollowing | controller | calls listUserFollowing(ctx, ctx.ContextUser) |
| 2 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | user.listUserFollowing | controller | gets list options from query params; calls GetUserFollowing; sets Link and X-Total-Count headers; calls responseAPIUsers |
| 3 | [models](../modules/models.md) | user_model.GetUserFollowing | repository | SELECT user.* JOIN follow ON user.id=follow.follow_id WHERE follow.user_id=? AND user.type IN (individual, organization) AND visibility filter; applies pagination; FindAndCount |
| 4 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | user.responseAPIUsers | utility | converts each user to api.User via convert.ToUser; returns JSON 200 |
